info.title: SUAS API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the implemented `/api/v0` surface. Authentication is an opaque Bearer credential; this API never reads cookies. Browser callers on origins listed in `SUAS_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` receive CORS headers and preflight answers (D-038, released in spec 0.7.0); other browser-originated unsafe requests receive `403 FORBIDDEN`. Paths document what the runtime registers today; draft APIS.md Plane A paths that are not yet implemented are intentionally absent.

200.description: The request after the edit, with the same fields as the detail read. On an idempotent replay the current detail is returned with replayed true; the edited text is never stored with the idempotency record.

409.description: ILLEGAL_TRANSITION when the request was accepted or is not SUBMITTED, TRIAGED or MATCHING; STALE_STATE when expected_status does not match

post.description: Requester only (404 for anyone who is neither requester nor accepter). Category never changes. Idempotency-Key is required.

RELEASE (proposal: suas-specs V1_MVP_PROPOSAL.md R8.5, not released) is the accepter's command: it needs a reason (400 VALIDATION_FAILED without one) and moves an ACCEPTED request back to SUBMITTED. The holder and accept time are cleared, the chat thread is closed, the request returns to the open list, and the requester gets an in-app notice. The same helper may accept it again; the next accept opens a new chat thread.

403.description: FORBIDDEN, or VERIFICATION_REQUIRED when a requester submits before passing the ID scan + selfie check

post.description: SUBMIT, CANCEL and CONFIRM may be run only by the requester; every other command only by the person who accepted this request (403 for the requester; 404 for anyone else, including another helper on the same case). SUBMIT needs a meeting_place on the request for FOOD, TRANSPORTATION and SHELTER (422 UNPROCESSABLE). Only SUBMIT needs a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise); the other commands do not. A command whose transition needs a reason (for example CANCEL) sent without one is 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Plain request form: create a Service Request
post.description: Same result as submitting a draft, with no assistant. Shown whenever the assistant is unavailable. Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise). Requires a county (422 COUNTY_REQUIRED).

post.summary: Accept an open service request (first accept wins)

200.description: Accepted (or the same answer again for the person who already holds it)

post.description: Accepts this one Service Request: records the caller as its holder and moves it to ACCEPTED in one transaction (peer accept: no provider consent evaluation, because the accepter is a peer). Other requests of the same Veteran stay open to other people. A first accept on an OPEN case also moves the case to ASSIGNED. First accept wins: a second person gets 409 ALREADY_CLAIMED. The accepter then runs START, FULFILL; the requester runs CONFIRM.

get.description: Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise).

200.description: Availability and the plain request form to use otherwise

post.description: Runs the Intake Assistant (two tools: search_resources, draft_service_request). A new Service Request Draft is stored only when the assistant answers (201). When it does not, nothing is stored and the response is 200 with outcome FALLBACK_FORM. The text is never logged. Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise).

200.description: Assistant unavailable or failed: show the plain request form

get.description: Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise).

200.description: Draft with the text you typed

patch.description: The Veteran changes the reviewed fields. Only an open draft can change. Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise).

post.description: Appends the text to the draft and runs the assistant again with the current draft. If the assistant fails the draft is unchanged and outcome is FALLBACK_FORM. Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise).

post.summary: Submit a draft as a Service Request
post.description: The only way a draft becomes a Service Request. Opens the Support Case if needed, creates the request and submits it. Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise). Requires a county (422 COUNTY_REQUIRED).

201.description: Service Request created from the draft. 422 UNPROCESSABLE when the draft is incomplete or a required meeting_place is missing.

post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Changes any subset of the draft fields; null clears an optional field. A draft that is already published or discarded returns 409 ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.

post.summary: Extract Resource Drafts from pasted source text
post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Sends the pasted text to the model and stores zero or more drafts with the source link. Output that fails validation creates no draft and returns 502 CATALOG_EXTRACTION_FAILED. Returns 503 CATALOG_BUILDER_UNAVAILABLE when no model is configured. Nothing here creates a Resource or reaches Veterans.

get.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Newest first, bounded by limit and cursor. `builder.available` is false, with a plain message, when the catalog builder cannot run; Resources can still be created without it.

post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Marks the draft REJECTED and keeps it on record; no Resource is created. Audited.

SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Creates the Resource, records the verification against the draft's source link, and activates it, in one transaction. The publish is the verification act; the model never sets last_verified_at. Audited.

200.description: Published draft and the new Resource id

201.description: Message stored; the other participant's live connections are notified on a best-effort basis

409.description: CHAT_UNAVAILABLE (not accepted yet), CHAT_CLOSED (a release closed the thread; the requester can still read it), or IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

post.summary: Issue a one-time WebSocket connect ticket (valid about 60 seconds, single use)
post.description: Open the WebSocket at websocket_url with ?ticket=<ticket>. The session credential is never sent in the URL. An expired, used or unknown ticket is refused at connect.

503.description: CHAT_REALTIME_UNAVAILABLE: live updates are not configured; messages still work over REST

200.description: The caller threads (as requester or accepter), newest activity first, at most 100

put.summary: Set the display name other people see
put.description: Signed-in only; no ID scan needed. Guidance for the form: "First name and last initial, like Marcus T." Only length and emptiness are validated.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque session credential from challenge verify

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key that makes a retried command safe (API.md §7). Reusing it with a different request is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

ResourceDraft.description: A Resource Draft. It has no verification fields and is never shown to Veterans.

source_link.description: http or https URL of the pasted source; kept on every draft and used as the verification source on publish.

tenant_id.description: Legacy filter; people do not choose an organization.

OpenCaseSummary.description: The current case of a Veteran: not RESOLVED or CLOSED. A Veteran whose case is resolved has none until they ask for help again, which opens a new case.

ActiveQrf.description: The caller's newest open Service Request, of any category (FOOD, TRANSPORTATION, SHELTER or PEER_SUPPORT).

is_admin.description: True when the person holds the SUAS System Administrator grant.

display_name.description: Trimmed, 1 to 40 characters. Guidance for the form: "First name and last initial, like Marcus T."

ResolveCaseRequest.description: The author, the accepter and the requester confirmation are derived on the server from the session (the person resolving must hold a request of the case); they are not accepted from the body.

ServiceRequestCommandRequest.description: SUBMIT, CANCEL and CONFIRM belong to the requester; every other command belongs to the person who accepted (403 otherwise).

details.description: Same bounded fields as the plain form. Unknown keys are refused (400).

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

meeting_place.description: Where to meet. Required to submit FOOD, TRANSPORTATION and SHELTER (422 UNPROCESSABLE); optional for PEER_SUPPORT. Never shown in lists.

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

summary.description: The requester one-line summary. Timing and meeting place are never listed.

county.description: ownership=open and mine only: the requester county.

counterpart_display_name.description: ownership=mine only: the requester display name.

closed_at.description: ownership=requested only: set once the request reached a terminal status.

counts.description: Proposal: suas-specs #69 Round 7 (D-057), not released; not authority until the spec is tagged and pins.ts re-pinned. ownership=mine only: summary counts for the caller as a helper, over the same requests as the mine list (all pages, not just this one). Never returned for another user or aggregated across users.

helping_now.description: Requests the caller accepted that are not in a terminal status (CLOSED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, UNFULFILLABLE). Includes CONFIRMED, which waits for the helper's CLOSE, and ESCALATED.

closed_last_30_days.description: Requests the caller accepted that reached CLOSED in the last 30 days (rolling 30 x 24 hours on the server clock, by terminal time, inclusive). CANCELLED is not counted as closed.

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

accepted_at.description: Proposal: suas-specs #69 Round 7 (D-057), not released; not authority until the spec is tagged and pins.ts re-pinned. When the request was accepted (the chat thread's creation time). null when no accept time is recorded: before accept, or legacy accepted requests. null does not mean not accepted. Not consent evidence (D-051). Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, like meeting_place.

counterpart_display_name.description: For the requester: the display name of the person who accepted (null until accepted or if unnamed). For the accepter: the requester display name.

viewer_role.description: The caller side of this request.

InviteTrustedContactRequest.description: At least one of invite_email and invite_phone is required.

outcome.description: FALLBACK_FORM: the assistant did not answer; nothing new was stored, show the plain request form (request_form).

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

total.description: Proposal: suas-specs #69 Round 7 (D-057), not released; not authority until the spec is tagged and pins.ts re-pinned. Resources matching the category and county filters across all pages, under the same tenant and visibility filters as the listed items.

last_message_body.description: Truncated to 140 characters; null when no message was sent yet.

accepted_at.description: Proposal: suas-specs #69 Round 7 (D-057), not released; not authority until the spec is tagged and pins.ts re-pinned. When the request was accepted (the thread's creation time; a thread exists only after accept). Always present in responses; optional in the contract so clients written before it still type-check. Not consent evidence (D-051).

closed.description: The request is in a terminal status.

closed_at.description: Proposal: suas-specs V1_MVP_PROPOSAL.md R8.5, not released. When a release closed this thread; null while it is live. A closed thread is read-only and only its requester sees it. Always present in responses; optional in the contract so clients written before it still type-check.

role.description: The caller side of the thread.

last_message_from_me.description: True when the latest message was sent by the caller; null when there are no messages.

BuildInfo.description: Build provenance (app commit/version, spec version, manifest, environment, schema version). No secrets.

meeting_place.description: null clears the meeting place; refused (422) for FOOD, TRANSPORTATION and SHELTER.

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

expected_status.description: Optional stale-state check; 409 STALE_STATE when the request is in another status.

ServiceRequestEditRequest.description: Fields to change. Absent keys stay as they are. At least one field other than expected_status is required (400).
